Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results provided by the WebSurfer in Step 3. While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved the dates for the Battle of Peleliu as "15 September to 27 November 1944" (visible in the search snippet from Wikipedia and History.com), the Planner hallucinated the year as 1914 in its analysis ("Peleliu: 15 September - 27 November 1914"). This misinterpretation led to the logically flawed conclusion that the Battle of Peleliu occurred earlier than the Battle of Belleau Wood (1918), when in reality, the Battle of Peleliu (1944) occurred later.
